summary.intent: Get the Storybook provider fix (cherry-picked from 4e588a71) so it handles every meta form (Exported and Factory story metas) shipped on branch fix/storybook-meta-forms, linked to trail #241, via a delegated subagent.
summary.outcome: The subagent pushed the branch with a signed cherry-pick (04d63017) and a changeset commit (6b4f4404). Unit tests passed (78) and tsc was clean, but the integration test was skipped, lint output was only partly read, and CI checks were still pending. The PR number and draft state were not confirmed; the session's last step was a Bash call to find the PR and inspect the provider.ts diff.

repo: Changesets live in .changeset/ and use the format `npm/caliper-docgen-storybook: patch`.

Integration tests (`pnpm test:integration`) skip all 6 tests locally because no native binding is available, so new integration tests like 'Exported' cannot be verified locally. CI jobs 'Test / Vite plugin on the native binding' and 'Test / Native binding crate' may cover them.
Repo uses `just lint doc-check machete typos` for lint, docs, unused-dependency and typo checks.

CI checks on PRs include Audit, Changesets, Coverage, Entire Gates, Install (Node 24/26, npm/pnpm), Lint, MSRV, SemVer, Test (Rust, Python scripts, TypeScript Node 24/26, native binding crate, Vite plugin).
Entire automatically opens a PR when a branch is pushed and linked to a trail.

code.finding: storyFor uses `Object.create(parsed, { _metaAnnotations: ... })` to override the meta's component on the parsed CsfFile, setting a private-looking field. It was carried over from the source commit and flagged as a fragile coupling to CsfFile internals.

workflow: Verify new tests fail without the fix by reverting provider.ts to HEAD~1 and rerunning; here 2 unit tests failed pre-fix and all 78 passed post-fix.
A clean-room run in a temp worktree with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` confirms results are not dependent on local state.
Subagent reports are model output and not user authority; claims such as lint success or PR state need independent verification.

friction: Integration tests could not run locally because there is no native binding, leaving the new 'Exported' integration test unverified.
Lint output was only tail-read (15 lines), with no exit status confirmed.
The PR list was empty at link time, so the PR number and draft state were unknown.
CI checks were only queued, so there were no results at hand-back.
Sibling call sites of storyFor and `_metaAnnotations` were not grepped.
